programs.name: mkparfile
programs.purpose: Convert two columns of ASCII numbers into two comma-separated parameter vectors.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: MKPARFILE - convert ascii to par file format

params.name: string1
params.description: Name of the parameter vector made from the first input column.

params.name: string2
params.description: Name of the parameter vector made from the second input column.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Input values are parsed as float and printed with %g, so decimal values are rounded to float and output formatting depends on the C library and locale.
programs.difficulty_reason: It parses two ASCII columns and writes each column as a parameter vector.

test_cases.description: Convert generated trace headers using the default parameter names.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=8 ntr=3 | sugethw key=tracl,ns output=geom | mkparfile

test_cases.description: Use custom parameter names and generated header values.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=16 ntr=4 | sugethw key=tracl,ns output=geom | mkparfile string1=tnmo string2=vnmo

programs.name: tvnmoqc
programs.purpose: Check time and velocity parameter pairs for each CDP and optionally write them to column files.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: TVNMOQC - Check tnmo-vnmo pairs; create t-v column files

params.name: mode
params.description: Set to 1 for checking or 2 for checking and writing one time-velocity file per CDP; other values perform checking without writing files.

params.name: prefix
params.description: Output filename prefix; required when mode=2. Files are named prefix.cdp.

params.name: cdp
params.description: CDP values; one value is required for each repeated tnmo and vnmo pair.

params.name: tnmo
params.description: Repeated time arrays, one per CDP. Each must contain at least one value and match the corresponding vnmo array length; non-increasing times produce warnings.

params.name: vnmo
params.description: Repeated velocity arrays, one per CDP. Each must contain at least one value and match the corresponding tnmo array length.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Times and velocities are parsed as float, and time ordering is checked after float rounding. Mode 2 prints values with %g, whose formatting depends on the C library and locale. The fixed 80-byte output filename buffer can overflow for a long prefix.
programs.difficulty_reason: It validates parameter arrays, compares adjacent times, and optionally writes ASCII files.

test_cases.description: Check two valid CDP time-velocity pairs.
Write one file per CDP and inspect the results.
test_cases.command: tvnmoqc mode=2 prefix=tvqc cdp=15,35 tnmo=0.0,0.5 vnmo=1500,2000 tnmo=0.0,1.0 vnmo=1600,2400 && cat tvqc.15 tvqc.35

test_cases.description: Exercise the warning for non-increasing times.
Exercise the mismatched time and velocity counts error.
